name: Password Change Success
summary: An authenticated user proves the current password and replaces it with a valid new password for the same durable identity.
finalOutcome: The password credential for the current durable identity has been replaced and the user remains the same identity.

sourceReferences.note: ChangePasswordAsync provides the existing credential-replacement implementation.
Normalized AuthenticationFlow implementation now provides the stable application entry point for password change.
Integration proof exercises the real flow, PasswordManager and LagoVista Identity adapter before the Microsoft Identity boundary.
